research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AliveCor is researching and developing mobile and handheld devices and systems for cardiac monitoring, including methods for determining optimal auscultation locations, blood pressure monitoring using mobile devices, and digital stethoscopes. Their work includes ECG sensors in packaging, machine learning health analysis, multi-parameter monitoring, mobile QT analysis, and systems for ECG signal detection and interpretation. These areas focus on mobile cardiac health solutions and physiological monitoring.

overview_description.description:
AliveCor has a device and application that will turn any smartphone into a clinical-quality electrocardiogram (ECG) recorder. AliveCor is pioneering the creation of FDA-cleared 'machine learning' techniques to enable proactive heart care and is recognized around the world for transforming cardiac care. It specializes in the fields of healthcare, mobile device, and medicine.

It was founded in 2010 and headquartered in Mountain View, California.

about_short_description.short_description: AliveCor is a FDA-cleared mobile heart solution that helps save lives, save money, and brings healthcare into the 21st century.

product.name: KardiaMobile 6L
product.description: A portable, FDA-cleared six-lead personal ECG device that records clinical-quality heart rhythm data through a compatible mobile device.

product.name: Kardia 12L
product.description: A portable 12-lead ECG device for healthcare professionals that captures clinical ECG recordings and transmits them through Bluetooth for review, printing, or electronic sharing.

product.name: KardiaPro
product.description: A clinician-facing platform for managing patient ECG recordings, reviewing rhythm data, and supporting remote cardiac monitoring workflows.

product.name: KardiaComplete
product.description: A connected cardiac-care service combining personal ECG monitoring, digital heart-health tools, and access to clinician-supported management for eligible users.

product.name: AliveCor AI
product.description: AI and machine-learning software that analyzes ECG recordings and classifies selected heart rhythms to support patient monitoring and clinical review.

product.name: Clinical Trial ECG Solutions
product.description: A service for collecting, analyzing, reviewing, and reporting ECG data in onsite or decentralized clinical trials across therapeutic areas and trial phases.
